ios.desc:
MUSE: TRACK & IMPROVE YOUR BRAIN HEALTH

The Muse app, designed for use with all Muse devices, is your gateway to better brain health and enhanced cognitive performance. Pair your Muse device to unlock features that help you monitor your brain activity, improve focus, and optimize your sleep.

TRACK YOUR COGNITIVE PERFORMANCE

Gain insights into your brain health by tracking your Alpha Peak Frequency over time. With Muse, understand your cognitive performance and take steps to improve it through tailored guidance and actionable insights.
*Available to all Muse, Muse 2, and Muse S users who have the premium subscription

ENHANCE YOUR FOCUS WITH BIOFEEDBACK

Use Muse’s Biofeedback Sessions to sharpen your focus. Get real-time audio feedback on your brain, body, heart, and breath, helping you stay in the moment and improve concentration. Stay motivated with personalized challenges, set weekly goals, and monitor your progress with easy-to-understand post-session reports.
*Available to all Muse, Muse 2, and Muse S users.

IMPROVE YOUR SLEEP QUALITY

Muse offers advanced sleep tracking and tools to help you fall asleep faster and stay asleep longer. With Digital Sleeping Pills (DSPs) that use smart-fade technology, experience soothing auditory experiences that ease you into sleep and help you return to rest if you wake up during the night. Explore Sleep Journeys, Guidances, and Soundscapes to further enhance your sleep quality.
*Available to Muse S users only.

MUSE PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION

Unlock even more with Muse Premium:
1. External Audio: Pair your Muse device with your favorite apps for enhanced feedback and guidance.
2. 500+ Guided Meditations: Access a vast library of guided meditations on topics like stress, sleep, and focus—no headband required.
3. Track your Cognitive performance: Establish your baseline & get your personalized Alpha Peak score for sharper focus, faster decision-making, improved memory retention and greater mental clarity
*Available in English. Monthly and yearly subscriptions can be purchased by anyone. An auto-renewing annual subscription is included with any Muse Premium Subscription Bundle purchase.

PRICING & TERMS

Choose from two auto-renewing subscription options:
 $12.99 per month
 $94.99 per year
Prices are for U.S. customers. Pricing in other countries may vary, and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on your country of residence.

Payment will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes ac

quotes.text:
I backed the indiegogo campaign with hopes that Muse would be very hacker friendly, but so far their SDK support is limited. They provide very low level interfaces for interacting with the data over bluetooth, but are behind scheduling on releasing their 'LibMuse' which promises to be a higher level SDK (in multiple languages) to help people build apps. I don't have links right now but after browsing their forums they seem to have de-prioritized their developer tools in favor of their own in-house apps. This is disappointing both as a developer who'd like to harness my Muse and as a consumer who wants to be able to do more things with my Muse than their single Calm app [1]

[1] https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/muse-calm/id849841170?mt=8
